mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL((SELECT SUM(balance) FROM account WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}), 0) + IFNULL((SELECT SUM(hold_amount) FROM member_finance_product WHERE member_no = #{memberNo}), 0)
SELECT account_id, bank_name, account_no, balance FROM account WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY account_id

SELECT mfp.link_no AS link_no, fp.product_name AS product_name, fp.org_name AS org_name, DATE_FORMAT(mfp.maturity_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS maturity_date FROM member_finance_product mfp INNER JOIN finance_product fp ON mfp.product_no = fp.product_no WHERE mfp.member_no = #{memberNo} AND mfp.maturity_date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mfp.maturity_date
